name: Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening Complete Edition + Collector's Set
storyline:
Players are supported by faithful retainers who act on their own judgement. The "Dominion" system will allow players to obtain and grant territory to retainers, so they can divvy up and parcel out the beautifully detailed Warring States Japan as they like, and make it prosper!
The game will also include a large variety of high-quality features befitting of the 40th anniversary of the series, including submission, direct talks, council officials, sieges, castle roles, and province plans, allowing the lords and their retainers to progress as one.
From famous officers to beautiful princesses, over 2,200 officers will be included, the greatest number in the series. Players can now come together with highly individualistic retainers and move history!
summary:
"NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening," where players can truly experience the Warring States period with officers who make decisions for themselves, now has a collector's edition that includes various add-on content that has been released, along with an officer artbook and complete soundtrack.

The contents:
In addition to "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Complete Edition" and all its add-on content, the collector's set includes:
- The "Kou Shibusawa's 40th Anniversary Commemorative Officer Data Set,"
- "Digital Officer Artbook," "Digital NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION 40th Anniversary Commemorative Book,"
- "Digital Complete Soundtrack."
For more details about the collector's edition contents, please see the official site (https:///).
